task_meta.title: Improve an ugly, inaccessible signup form

judge.reasons: Calm centred dark card with clear heading, intro, labelled fields and a dominant full-width submit; mobile fits cleanly with 44px+ targets. Error, submitting and success states and ARIA wiring can't be verified from screenshots; hint text is small.

claim_text: I've redesigned the signup page into a clean card layout that fits a 390px phone with no sideways scrolling. I tested it in headless Chrome at 390px, in light and dark mode. Empty submit, bad input, the "already registered" email, submitting and success all behaved correctly, wit
digest: Read 8 files (3 before its first edit), made 4 edits, ran tests 5 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
